fields.hero_prompt: Build a free trial landing page that saves every signup to a database I own.

faq_plan.q: What is a free trial landing page?
How do I create a free trial landing page?

plan.angle: The SERP for free trial landing page is example galleries (Unbounce, Instapage, Swipe Pages, Apexure), a wireframe template on Pinterest and a Reddit thread asking for conversion numbers: plenty of screenshots, but none of them say what the signup form should ask, whether to take a card, or what the page must say about the day the trial ends. This page shows four free trial landing pages where the offer is explicit (trial length, card or no card, the price after) and every trial start is saved with the place it came from, then builds them. SaaS, demo, startup, pricing-page and lead-generation landing pages are siblings and stay out of the headings.
tab_stories: Harlowe, scheduling software for tutors, runs a 14-day trial with no card: its page asks for email and company only (2 fields), and of the 47 trials started this week, 29 came from the header button and 18 from the pricing link.

Quillbrook, a photo proofing tool for wedding photographers, takes a card for its 7-day trial, so the page puts the $29 a month price beside the form and a line under the button saying the card is charged on day 8 unless the trial is canceled.

Kelswick Climbing, a climbing gym, offers a pass good for 3 visits in 7 days: the page's form asks name and email, the pass arrives by email with a code, and the front desk screen shows 21 passes claimed this week with 13 already used for a first visit.

Saltmere, a newsletter tool for food bloggers, served two headlines for 2 weeks to the same page and counted trial starts per variant: headline B started 58 of the 96 trials and headline A started 38, so B became the only headline.
openers: Harlowe sells scheduling software to tutors
Quillbrook takes a card before its 7-day trial starts
Kelswick Climbing gives first-timers a pass
Saltmere served two headlines to the same page
Write the offer in one sentence
Decide whether the trial takes a card
Keep the signup form to the fields the first session needs
Publish on a domain you own
heading_shapes: Two fields, then straight into the product (count first, then the outcome)
Card trials say what $29 buys and when (price inside a verb phrase)
One pass, 3 visits, 7 days to use them (three beats, all numbers)
Headline B started 58 trials and won the page (result, then the verdict)
claims_to_source: An opt-in free trial does not require payment details at signup; an opt-out free trial collects payment details and converts to a paid subscription automatically unless the customer cancels
